【原视频简介】
I survived 100 DAYS as a Jujutsu Sorcerer in Minecraft! ⚡

I started with nothing and slowly learned cursed techniques, joined a Jujutsu clan, unlocked powerful abilities, fought cursed spirits, and even went up against some of the strongest characters from Jujutsu Kaisen.

But things got crazy when I faced Mahito and eventually the King of Curses... Sukuna. 💀

This is only the FIRST 50 DAYS of my journey. Can I become strong enough to defeat Sukuna and become the strongest Jujutsu Sorcerer?

🔥 Watch until the end to see how far I made it!

If you enjoyed the video, make sure to LIKE 👍
SUBSCRIBE for more Minecraft 100 Days videos!
